response.original_title: The Patients We Fear: Life in a Forensic Psychiatric Hospital
response.overview: Behind the locked doors of a forensic psychiatric hospital, people who have committed violent crimes while suffering from severe mental illness struggle for a second chance. With unprecedented access to the Brockville Mental Health Centre, this documentary follows patients undergoing treatment in an institution rarely seen by the public. Over 18 months, both patients and staff reveal the realities of life inside—where recovery, responsibility, and risk are constantly weighed.  As some patients prepare to return to society, the film raises a difficult question: can those who committed violent acts while mentally ill truly be rehabilitated—and will society ever accept them?
response.title: The Patients We Fear: Life in a Forensic Psychiatric Hospital
